stops.note: to preserve, from Latin conficere (to prepare, put together)
settled in French for meat slow-cooked and preserved in its own fat
stops.meaning: meat preserved by slow cooking in fat

stops.note: duck confit is a specialty of Gascony, where meat was preserved in its own fat through winter
stops.meaning: food slow-cooked and preserved, especially in fat

current_meaning: food, especially meat, cooked slowly and preserved, traditionally in its own fat
